correctness.rationale: Direct graph-geodesic proof for every prime power q and d>=4: omitted skew lines require selected endpoint; omitted meeting lines have a selected transversal yielding a length-two geodesic. Every intersecting-line family is concurrent or coplanar; k>=2 concurrent families have a unique point, while nonconcurrent families have a unique plane. The Gaussian coefficients and plane concurrence correction count every family exactly once. All maximality and d=4/5 claims follow. Independent enumerative check against actual graph cliques passed for (q,d)=(2,4),(3,4),(2,5); finite tests do not establish the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: An exact size-distribution polynomial for all strong metric landmark sets over every rank-two finite Grassmann graph is a natural complete classification, not an arbitrary slice. It captures all allowed deletion counts, two canonical minimal families, the d=4 dual boundary and an unbounded gap between inclusion-minimal solution sizes for d>=5. Mathematical value is in the full counting invariant and structural all-set characterization; prior maximal-clique classification and known minimum dimensions are not claimed as new.
